about:
Western Maine Supply operates from Bethel, Maine, where it was established in 1964 as a small, locally owned business serving the community with a core selection of hardware, paints, and building materials. The company has remained locally owned and operated since its founding, expanding to its current Cross Street location to broaden product offerings and better serve the region.

The business functions as a full-service lumber yard and building supply retailer. Its facilities include a drive-thru warehouse, a window and door warehouse, and an on-site carpenter shop that historically supported both contractors and homeowners. A modern fleet of seven delivery trucks — comprising boom trucks, a Moffett truck, a box truck, and multiple flatbeds — handles free delivery across the service area. Additional services encompass kitchen and bath design, glass pane cutting, key cutting, special orders, contractor accounts, and project estimates.

The company serves homeowners and contractors throughout western Maine. Typical customers are remodeling summer camps, updating existing homes, or building new houses. Contractors rely on dedicated accounts for timely material supply. Product categories span building supplies (lumber, plywood, sheetrock, molding, insulation, framing, windows, doors, siding, shingles), kitchen and bath cabinetry, flooring (hardwood, laminate), plumbing, electrical, tools, hardware, paints, stains, lawn and garden, and hardscapes.

Western Maine Supply emphasizes its continuity of ownership and adherence to founding values: respect for customers, knowledgeable guidance, and dependable service. Free delivery is highlighted as a longstanding priority, backed by the dedicated truck fleet.
